description:
Review uncommitted vault changes, then stage and commit all of them with git.

Subcommands:
  review [--max-file-lines N] [--max-lines N] — show everything changed since the last commit; read-only
  save --message SUBJECT [--body TEXT] [--dry-run] — stage every change in the vault and commit it

Flags:
  review: --max-file-lines is the maximum number of diff lines per file (default 150). --max-lines is the maximum total output lines (default 3000). Long diffs are truncated.
  save: --message is required and must be one non-empty line. --body is the commit body and may span several lines. --dry-run reports what would be staged and committed, and changes nothing.

Examples:
  ["review"]
  ["save", "--message", "Log SGB review meeting and follow-up tasks", "--body", "Added meeting note, 3 tasks, 3h hours entry."]
  ["save", "--message", "Record September payments", "--dry-run"]

Notes:
  Run review first and write the message from what it shows, then run save.
  save stages everything in the vault. It only adds a commit: it never amends, resets or pushes.
  Exit 1: message empty or more than one line, vault is not a git repository or is not its root, or a git command failed.
